name: 69 Hearts • One Journey
greetingText: Our MBA journey is ending… but the memories we created together will never end.
wishText: May every one of us achieve the dreams we started this journey with. Wishing you success, happiness and a beautiful future ahead. ✨
text1: Our MBA LIFE is coming to an end… 🎓
textInChatBox: To all my wonderful friends — thank you for every laugh, every class moment, every IV, every discussion, every crazy memory and every moment we shared. I will truly miss you all. ❤️
text3: And we may have belonged to different teams.
text4: But whenever one person faced a problem,
text5Entry: That was the real strength of our MBA journey…
outroText: Different teams. Different personalities. Different dreams. But one unforgettable journey. Thank you, guys, for making our MBA life extraordinary.
